title: 'Minsan pumapalpak kayo': Tulfo scolds prosecution over impeachment witnesses
summary: Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo on Thursday told prosecutors in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte to be more discerning in their choice of witnesses.
